ONE STOP-LOSS. TWO SKIPPED COINS. AND A $2,860 WIN NOBODY MENTIONS

then he posted the overnight clip. here's what it shows

18 trades on 5 coins
1 stop-loss
2 coins skipped
37.81x on the final card

at 0:09 the bot buys a copycat of the coin it wanted and gets stopped out for -$11.39. it writes the mistake into its notes

at 0:19 it skips a coin because only bot wallets are buying

the post is all about one coin, fiona the hippo. her last sell at 0:18 adds +$269.23

the daily note at 0:24 says the biggest win came from somewhere else:

"cool dog after a -55% flush: +$2,860.01"

cool dog isn't in the post at all

its lesson that morning: "trail the last third", after one position gave back 75%

$117.43 → $4,439.89

it kept a log of what went wrong. that's the part a final green screenshot leaves out
